03_cruise_start.prompt: A small disc-shaped spacecraft with solar panels drifts through dark space, a tiny blue Earth far behind it on the left and a small red Mars ahead on the right. 04_entry_start.prompt: A blunt cone-shaped capsule plunges into the thin atmosphere of Mars heat shield first, wrapped in a glowing orange and white plasma trail that streams out behind it. Far below, the red surface curves away under a dark violet sky. nsc7 style
